timing: Specified after v2 results, v3 cached baseline and registered-endpoint perturbation summaries were inspected, before this candidate-specific numerical profile. Not preregistered or an independent replication.
source: Existing image_features.measure diagnostics.paired_colour.floral_union.lab_chroma. Do not request images or modify any saved all27 endpoint.
definition: On the original EXIF-oriented head crop, use the union of the unchanged white, redmagenta, purple and yellow pixel masks from engine 56. Convert encoded BGR uint8 pixels with OpenCV COLOR_BGR2LAB and take median(sqrt((a8-128)^2+(b8-128)^2)) over that union. Never switch the mask according to dominant colour. This original-crop statistic is not the legacy original/mirror average.
support: Retain every raw candidate value and every scheduled head. For inherited-QC summaries require the saved registered corolla_lab_chroma endpoint status to be usable, a finite union chroma in [0, sqrt(2)*128], a positive floral pixel count, and head minimum dimension at least 96 px. This deliberately inherits the existing colour-confidence rule, including its dominance term; it is not a claim of unbiased selection or a newly validated mask.
context: Use green_non_head_context from the same condition and head. Matched floral, green and floral-minus-green summaries require the floral eligibility above plus saved green support_status=available and a finite bounded green chroma. Insufficient context remains a missing comparison, not zero or a passed negative control. Green pixels are not verified leaf tissue.
population: Every head in the pinned completed cached perturbation grid, all 14 conditions, and all three historical-development-exposure strata. No value, taxon or environmental association selection.
weighting: Use summarize_perturbations.summarize_frame: heads within image, images within known source component, then equal component weights. Keep all four QC transitions and loss from groups with no surviving pairs.
decision: Report every condition's absolute and signed shifts, rank agreement where estimable, and eligibility losses. No p-values, favourable pass threshold, recipe choice by environmental signal, calibrated measurement-error variance, independent accuracy claim, or automatic ecological admission.
limits: The mask itself depends on encoded image colour and can change under illumination probes; uniform refers to the same rule, not invariant pixels.
Synthetic colour and crop operations do not reproduce all real camera, illumination, developmental or selection effects.
The legacy comparison includes both mask-selection and original-versus-mirror-aggregation differences; it does not isolate one cause.
CIELAB-like camera-space chroma is not reflectance, anthocyanin concentration or a biological pigment calibration.
A full technical profile does not complete the production-cohort assessability or ecological measurement model.
